issues.description: The problem statement (UML and text) requires the Animal constructor and the getName/setName methods to have protected visibility, but the solution implementation declares them as public. This visibility mismatch between specification and solution can confuse students about the intended access level for these members and may lead to inconsistencies when students follow the written instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification by changing the Animal constructor and the getName/setName methods to protected in Animal.java (i.e., replace 'public' with 'protected'), or alternatively update the problem statement to accept public visibility. Prefer keeping the constructor and accessors protected to match the UML and textual instructions.
